item.title: Josh Harris Just Bought Washington’s Most Expensive House. Ever!
item.description: Josh Harris just set a D.C. record, paying $28M for Georgetown’s historic Halcyon House. Here’s why the deal matters.

item.title: Porsche’s Electric Boat Is Exactly What You’d Expect - in a Good Way
item.description: Porsche builds an electric boat with Frauscher, using the Macan’s full EV drivetrain. Quiet, clever, and engineered exactly as you’d expect.

item.title: Inside Mandapa’s new 21,000-square-foot River Estate in the Heart of Ubud
item.description: Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, unveils a new riverfront estate in Ubud, blending Balinese architecture, space, and a deep sense of place.

item.title: La Regatta Métiers d’Art is L’Epée 1839’s Most Expressive Take Yet
item.description: L’Epée 1839 expands La Regatta with Métiers d’Art enamel, turning its vertical table clock into a series of unique, hand-finished mechanical objects.

item.title: Bentley’s new Continental GT S: Luxury, With Its Gloves Off
item.description: Bentley’s new Continental GT S blends a thunderous V8, hybrid punch, and a sharper chassis into the most driver-focused Continental yet.

item.title: Kempinski Makes Its U.S. Move, Starting in Miami’s Design District
item.description: Kempinski enters the U.S. residential market in Miami, using branded residences and hospitality-led management as its strategic foothold.

item.title: Benetti B.Neos: Hybrid Power, Quiet Luxury, and Real Comfort at Sea
item.description: Benetti B.Neos is a 131-foot hybrid superyacht focused on quiet luxury, smart design, and a calmer way to cruise at sea.

item.title: Bulgari’s €157,000 Secret Watch Is Literally Covered in Money
item.description: Bulgari made a watch that hides time behind an ancient Roman coin, stacking history, jewelry, and mechanics into one discreet luxury object.

item.title: A Princess Is Selling Her €36 Million Lake Garda Estate, Castle and Church Included
item.description: A princess has listed her €36 million estate above Lake Garda, complete with a castle, a medieval church, vineyards, and modern infrastructure.

item.title: Bugatti’s One-Off W16 Mistral Is a Pearl in the Literal Sense
item.description: Bugatti unveils the one-of-one W16 Mistral “La Perle Rare,” a pearl-finished roadster celebrating the final chapter of the legendary quad-turbo W16 engine.
